hooks.command: if printf '%s' "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'mlflow[[:space:]]+(gc|db[[:space:]]+upgrade)' && [ "${MLFLOW_MAINTENANCE_ACK:-}" != "yes" ]; then echo 'Blocked: mlflow gc / mlflow db upgrade are destructive. Get explicit user confirmation (and a DB snapshot for db upgrade), then re-run with MLFLOW_MAINTENANCE_ACK=yes.' >&2; exit 2; fi
